title: Concept: Test tooling compiles into the shipped binary
description: Cargo.toml declares a test-only crate declared as a runtime dependency, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a test-only crate declared as a runtime dependency.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a test-only crate declared as a runtime dependency.
